repositories.name: JobOS
repositories.description: JobOS helps junior software engineers discover recent LinkedIn and company job offers, track applications, find public recruitment contacts, and tailor CVs and email drafts using Ollama or API models.

repositories.name: BigData
repositories.description: A real-time data engineering pipeline. It features a Python-based producer for sensor data simulation, Spark Structured Streaming for live processing, and automated ingestion into HDFS/Hadoop for persistent Big Data storage. Fully containerized with Docker.

repositories.name: RetinaScan
repositories.description: A deep learning-powered medical imaging platform for detecting ocular diseases from retinal scans. Features a CNN-based classification engine (TensorFlow/Keras), a Spring Boot backend for secure medical record management, and a Vite/React dashboard for clinical analysis and statistics.

repositories.name: TalentAI
repositories.description: AI-Powered Recruitment Platform : A Full-stack application utilizing Spring AI (Ollama/Llama3) for automated CV scoring, data extraction, and interview question generation. Features a React frontend, PostgreSQL database, and a robust DevOps pipeline with Jenkins, SonarQube, and Kubernetes.

repositories.name: NosqlAPT
repositories.description: An advanced multi-stage threat detection system for Advanced Persistent Threats (APT). Utilizes a hybrid Deep Learning (Autoencoder) and Machine Learning (XGBoost) architecture to identify anomalies and malicious stages in network and system logs. Features a containerized ELK Stack integration for real-time monitoring.

repositories.name: AI-Agents
repositories.description: Local OS Supervisor Agent powered by Ollama (Llama 3.2). Features intelligent document analysis (PDF, Docx, Python), real-time system monitoring, and automated email triage through a Streamlit interface.

repositories.name: AgentFleet
repositories.description: A full-stack orchestration platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Docker to deploy, monitor, and manage a fleet of autonomous AI developer agents. Features real-time container status tracking via Dockerode, a centralized command dashboard, and isolated execution environments.

repositories.name: pfa-php
repositories.description: A dynamic web application designed for academic collaboration between students and professors. Features include real-time messaging, post sharing, friend request management, and role-based profiles (Professor/Student). Built with PHP, MySQL, and CSS3.

repositories.name: ScootRent-JEE
repositories.description: A robust, multi-role web application for electric scooter rentals. Built with Java EE (Servlets/JSP) and MySQL, it features real-time reservation tracking, automated PDF billing with iText, and a dynamic dashboard for both clients and administrators.

repositories.name: fb-reels-automator
repositories.description: A lightweight Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) designed to automate interactions with Facebook Reels while building a structured dataset for activity analysis.
